svg.title: Slide6 Update2
svg.desc: Plot: Particle filter after its second measurement update on a 10 by 10 meter map with landmarks at (2, 8), (8, 8) and (8, 2). Green range circles around each landmark intersect near (4, 4.2), where the true robot pose (red arrow) and estimated mean pose (purple arrow) nearly coincide, both heading up and to the right. Most particles form a dense cluster there, with a second cluster near (3.5, 5.8) and a few stragglers. Gray trails show particle paths. All particle weights fall low on the 0 to 0.005 color scale.
